name: Fuente Álamo de Murcia (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided silver grey over green.
history: The Governing Council of the Region of Murcia approved the new flag of Fuente Álamo de Murcia by decree 1/2015 of 23 January 2015; the municipal flag has a proportion of 2:3 and is divided into two horizontal stripes of equal size, the lower green (Pantone 355 C) and the upper silver grey (Pantone Cool Gray 3 C).
